description: Compare two to six products on the attributes they all publish. Rows where every product has a value come back as comparable; rows where some do not are returned separately with the products that have no recorded value named, so a blank is never read as a worse figure. Fortitude21 does not rank its products against each other, and the tool does not either: which one suits an application depends on the contents, the destination market and the order.

skus.description: Two to six part numbers or slugs

name: compare_products
title: Compare Fortitude21 products
